result.title: Variational Monte Carlo for Quantum Excited States via Nested Low-Rank Approximation
result.comment: Accepted for NeurIPS 2026. The first two authors contributed equally. 41 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/MinchanJeong/NestedLoRA-VMC
result.summary: The electronic Schrödinger equation encodes a molecule's electronic structure and quantum properties, but solving it scales exponentially with the number of electrons. Solving this equation with neural-network variational Monte Carlo (VMC) has reached chemical accuracy on the ground state of small molecules; extending this success to excited states is constrained by two existing paradigms. Penalty-based methods need $K$ Laplacians per step but require tuning the overlap-penalty weights against the energy gaps they aim to compute. Natural excited states VMC (NES-VMC) is penalty-free, but it combines the $K$ ansatzes into one determinant, whose local energy requires $K^2$ Laplacians per step. We resolve this trade-off via low-rank approximation (LoRA) reparameterization of the rank-$K$ variational objective. The reparameterized objective admits a VMC-compatible stochastic gradient estimator via MCMC sampling from the per-state Born densities, and a sequential nesting scheme recovers the lowest $K$ eigenstates in eigenvalue order. The resulting algorithm, NestedLoRA-VMC, inherits a global optimality guarantee from the LoRA principle. On the first-row atoms Li through Ne at $K=10$, its accuracy is comparable to that of NES-VMC and of a state-of-the-art penalty-based method.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向量子化学激发态求解，用低秩（LoRA）重参数化嵌套变分目标，提出可在 MCMC 采样下做随机梯度估计的 NestedLoRA-VMC，以接近已有方法精度恢复最低 K 个本征态。
AI.relevance_reason: 全文围绕电子薛定谔方程的本征态数值求解，其中的「state」是物理本征态而非推理状态，与视觉细节保留、latent 生成、证据筛选或停止决策均无具体联系，嵌套低秩结构也缺少可核查的迁移线索，故排除。
